label: Music & pitch
note: Song generation and the measurement tools that judge it. The biggest single swap here was driven by licence exposure, and the biggest single defect by one sampler parameter.

entities.name: MusicGen
entities.summary: The music engine until the channel was monetised. Weights removed and 14 generated mp3s quarantined the same day.

issues.text: CC-BY-NC on a monetised channel. Removed, not paused — weights deleted and 14 ag_*.mp3 quarantined.
The board kept a card titled 'MusicGen Background Music' after the swap, and the server's stage map keys off card titles — so 24 of 28 documentary cards could never leave queued.

entities.name: AudioGen
entities.summary: The generative foley tier. Removed with MusicGen and not replaced — SFX come from licensed libraries instead.

issues.text: CC-BY-NC. The whole generative foley tier was removed rather than swapped; nothing generates sound effects now.

entities.name: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo
entities.summary: The MIT engine that cleared the licence exposure and now writes every children's song. Guidance-distilled, 8 steps, cfg 1.0, euler/simple.

issues.text: Cleared the CC-BY-NC exposure on a monetised channel, which is why it was adopted at all.

Singing was only ~74% word-intelligible at the source while the lyric gate reported 96% — the gate prompted Whisper with the lyric sheet. Root cause found 10-04: a2a melody conditioning starts the sampler from the SCORE RENDER's latent, which is instrumental, and denoise 0.45 skipped the high-noise phase where a clearly articulated voice is decided.

Fixed by a per-song denoise LADDER (0.45/0.55/0.65) climbed only when under 80% of a take's lines are clear, not by a new default — the two songs that lost the tune at 0.55 were already clear at 0.45. Replayed: 49% → 94% of lines intelligible, melody kept 5/5.

Measured dead ends, do not retry: more STEPS (8→32) made clarity WORSE (8/12 → 4/12 clear) because it locks the instrumental source latent in harder, and COVER mode re-performs the instrumental reference and sings almost nothing (0/12 clear).
Only the guidance-distilled turbo checkpoint is installed, so whether a non-distilled ACE checkpoint would beat all of this is still unmeasured.
Text mode (no a2a) is 12/12 clear but chroma z 1.98 — maximum clarity, no tune. That trade is the shape of the lane.
A 210 s song loses its last 5 lines; the shipped rotation is 130/150/170 s and 130 s is clean.

entities.name: Praat
entities.summary: The pitch meter until sung material broke it. Retired for singing specifically.

issues.text: Unreliable on sung material, which is the only material this lane measures.

entities.name: sung_pitch.py (RMVPE)
entities.summary: RMVPE-based pitch tracking: raw pitch accuracy 0.971 on clean vocals and 0.967 through a demucs stem, so the register work could finally be measured rather than argued.

issues.text: RPA 0.971 clean / 0.967 through demucs — accurate enough that a stem is not a confound.
The sung register of the male voices turned out to be BIMODAL, which no single target pitch can describe.

entities.name: Demucs
entities.summary: Splits a delivered mix into stems for remixing and for measurement. Reliable for pitch, misleading for intelligibility.

issues.text: The vocal STEM is a worse intelligibility test than the mix — measured 66.9% coverage unprompted on the stem against 73.6% on the mix, so the gate now judges clarity on the mix.

entities.name: Score render soundfont
entities.role: the melody the song is conditioned on
entities.summary: Renders the written score that a2a conditioning starts from. Its licence is the reason the score render is a tool output, not a shipped asset.

issues.text: GPL-2 — usable to produce the conditioning render, but it constrains what can be distributed.
Because the score render is instrumental, it is also the exact cause of the mush defect: the sampler starts from a latent with no voice in it.
